Welcome.Slogan: I am passionately driven to transform my ideas into functional programs that exceed expectations.
Welcome.About:
Python Engineer / Developer focused on Data & Generative AI. Designer of high-performance RESTful APIs (FastAPI, PostgreSQL) and advanced RAG systems that bring the power of LLMs to targeted knowledge bases. Strong expertise in Web Scraping, data structuring and visualization, combined with rigorous software engineering based on Docker containerization. 
 
 Full-Stack Developer in modern web applications (TypeScript, Next.js) with polished UI/UX integration using recpectively the concept of Atomoc Design. 

 I mostly code with Opencode as Agentoc tool, with strong command of skills, commands and code rules / AGENTS.md.

 My specialty: monorepo architectures (Turborepo, Nx, pnpm workspaces) and microservices (event-driven, REST/tRPC, Docker), adding the TDD and DDD workdlow. 
 
 Curious, organized and solution-oriented, I combine empathy, teamwork and a passion for continuous learning to deliver clean, user-centered systems. Driven by innovation and continuous learning, I am always looking for new opportunities to push the boundaries of what is possible.
